---
title: "Examples"
---

Examples are generated downstream repository snapshots that demonstrate the generator contract.

## Basic Agentic Project

The first example lives at `examples/basic-agentic-project`.

It is generated with:

```bash
uv run python -m repo_familiar generate \
  --name "Basic Agentic Project" \
  --description "Example downstream repository generated by repo-familiar." \
  --output "examples/basic-agentic-project" \
  --agent-harness opencode \
  --agent-harness paseo \
  --agent-harness hermes \
  --model-profile default-coding \
  --model-profile budget-review \
  --reference-type git \
  --reference-url "https://example.invalid/repo-familiar.git" \
  --reference-ref example-snapshot \
  --generated-at "2026-05-10T00:00:00Z" \
  --force
```

The fixed `--generated-at` value keeps the snapshot deterministic. Tests regenerate the same example into a temporary directory and compare file contents.

## Example Policy

- Examples should be generated snapshots, not hand-written downstream repositories.
- Examples should use deterministic metadata where possible.
- Examples should double as regression fixtures for generator behavior.
